subject: Draft MAP, evidence & sequencing for Circadia pilot
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lee <sara.lee@circadia.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP, evidence & sequencing for Circadia pilot

Sara — attaching a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and a short sequencing note for the MSA/DPA/order form dependencies. Suggested cadence is a 6-week pilot + 3-week contracting window after pilot acceptance; I flagged the hard gates where we need legal/security artifacts to avoid last-minute stalls.

Quick highlights:
- Pilot start: target week of May 13 (kickoff + data ingest).
- Evidence needed: SOC 2 report or letter + security pack (attestation, network diagram, data flow).
- Contracting path: we recommend running the DPA in parallel with MSA redline review to shave ~2 weeks; order form finalized after pilot acceptance criteria met.

Attached: Circadia_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) — see column F for owner/ETA. I also dropped a Drive link in the file for editable copy.

Next steps: can you confirm procurement contact and any internal review windows at Circadia (legal lead, information security reviewer)? Once we have names I can loop our legal & security and propose a gating calendar.

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lee <sara.lee@circadia.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@circadia.com
Date: 2029-05-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, evidence & sequencing for Circadia pilot

Thanks, Olga — appreciate the clear MAP. A few clarifying Qs:

1) SOC 2: we can provide an in-scope SOC 2 Type II report but it will require our security team to validate any SSO/KMS integrations. How granular does Redwood need the report to be for pilot access?
2) DPA timing: procurement wants the DPA agreed before pilot starts (to satisfy our privacy board). Is running the DPA in parallel to MSA typical for you?
3) Order form: procurement prefers to have terms and list prices up front; can you share a placeholder order form with the pilot SKU and rate card so we can budget?

Also attaching our quick security questionnaire (Circadia_QS.pdf) — it's short. I'll loop our procurement lead (procurement@circadia.com) if that's helpful.

—Sara
Sara Lee
Head of Product, Integrations
Circadia Health

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-02T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP, evidence & sequencing for Circadia pilot — sequencing decisions needed

Team — forwarding Sara's note. Procurement at Circadia wants the DPA before pilot access; Sara attached their quick security questionnaire. Need quick alignment on sequencing so I can respond with a clear proposal.

Options I'm considering (pros/cons):
- Option A: DPA signed pre-pilot; MSA negotiation continues in parallel. Pro: satisfies buyer governance; Con: increases friction to start.
- Option B: DPA executed with a narrow pilot-scoped addendum (data use limited), MSA finalized post-pilot with commercial T&Cs. Pro: faster pilot start; Con: procurement may push back.

Specific asks: 
1) Rafael: can Legal commit to a first-pass redline within 5 business days if we provide an editable MSA template?
2) Karthik/Laura (sales ops): can we provide a placeholder order form + SKU/rate card this week to help procurement budget?
3) Security: what minimum evidence pack gets us pilot access (SOC 2 letter vs full report)?

If we can get commitments on the three asks, I will propose Option B with a clear risk register and gated escalation to procurement.

Thanks — quick replies appreciated; Sara is hoping to schedule kickoff next week.
Olga
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-03T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MAP, evidence & sequencing for Circadia pilot — sequencing decisions needed

Olga — thanks for the context. Quick sequencing recommendation from Legal (high level):

1) Run DPA parallel to MSA redline: provide a pilot-scoped DPA addendum that limits processing to pilot datasets and is revocable. This reduces legal friction but preserves privacy guardrails.
2) SOC 2: we accept a SOC 2 Type II report + a signed attestation letter from Circadia's security lead for pilot access. If Circadia can only provide a letter initially, we should insist on the full report before production.
3) MSA redline: Legal can turn a first-pass clean redline within 4 business days from receipt of the editable MSA. We'll call out the pilot scope as an interim schedule.
4) Order form: Sales ops should provide a placeholder order form (pilot SKU, unit pricing, term) — order form to be finalized after pilot acceptance metrics are met.

Attachments: Redlines_MSA_Circadia_v1.docx (editable redline template), Security_Evidence_Pack.zip (template list of evidence we need).

Next steps for Olga: share the attached redline + DPA addendum draft with Sara and request procurement to confirm whether a pilot-scoped DPA is acceptable. If they decline, we'll pivot to requiring a full DPA signed pre-pilot.

Rafael Mendes
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lee <sara.lee@circadia.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@circadia.com
Date: 2029-05-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, evidence & sequencing for Circadia pilot

Olga / team — thanks for the speedy follow-up and for sending Rafael's guidance. Procurement is OK with a pilot-scoped DPA addendum + SOC 2 attestation for pilot access; security will push the full SOC 2 report before any production rollout. Procurement also confirmed they received the placeholder order form you shared in the Drive and will slot budget for the pilot this quarter.

Let's target kickoff on May 14 (week of May 13) — Sara to send calendar invite today. Please include the security reviewer (cc'd in a follow-up) so they can validate network/access details ahead of kickoff.

Appreciate the quick coordination.
—Sara
